subject: Reimplement vectorized high-multiplies
perf_evidence: Commit reimplements 64-bit SIMD high multiplication to improve instruction selection across SSE2, AVX2 and AVX512.
change_summary: Rewrites the unsigned-64 high-half SIMD multiply in all three x86 vector-width implementations.

units.name: raw high-half multiply with arbitrary and repeated multiplier lanes, SSE2/AVX2/AVX512
units.precondition: repeated-lane subtarget matches the documented helper contract
units.evidence: Both raw targets time out in both directions for SSE2, AVX2 and AVX512 runs.

units.name: public generated signed/unsigned 64-bit branchfull and branchfree vector division, all three widths
units.evidence: All four public API targets time out in both directions on SSE2, AVX2 and AVX512, including the completed long AVX512 run.

notes: The functions compile to Alive2-supported fixed-width vector IR; solver timeouts, not an unsupported SIMD instruction, prevent a verdict.
